verses.text: The wicked flee when no one is pursuing, But the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.textZh: 惡人雖無人追趕也逃跑；義人卻膽壯像獅子。

verses.text: By the transgression of a land many are its princes, But by a man of understanding [and] knowledge, so it endures.
verses.textZh: 邦國因有罪過，君王就多更換；因有聰明知識的人，國必長存。

verses.text: A poor man who oppresses the lowly Is [like] a driving rain which leaves no food.
verses.textZh: 窮人欺壓貧民，好像暴雨沖沒糧食。

verses.text: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, But those who keep the law strive with them.
verses.textZh: 違棄律法的，誇獎惡人；遵守律法的，卻與惡人相爭。

verses.text: Evil men do not understand justice, But those who seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.textZh: 壞人不明白公義；惟有尋求耶和華的，無不明白。

verses.text: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than he who is crooked though he be rich.
verses.textZh: 行為純正的窮乏人勝過行事乖僻的富足人。

verses.text: He who keeps the law is a discerning son, But he who is a companion of gluttons humiliates his father.
verses.textZh: 謹守律法的，是智慧之子；與貪食人作伴的，卻羞辱其父。

verses.text: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury Gathers it for him who is gracious to the poor.
verses.textZh: 人以厚利加增財物，是給那憐憫窮人者積蓄的。

verses.text: He who turns away his ear from listening to the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.textZh: 轉耳不聽律法的，他的祈禱也為可憎。

verses.text: He who leads the upright astray in an evil way Will himself fall into his own pit, But the blameless will inherit good.
verses.textZh: 誘惑正直人行惡道的，必掉在自己的坑裡；惟有完全人必承受福分。

verses.text: The rich man is wise in his own eyes, But the poor who has understanding sees through him.
verses.textZh: 富足人自以為有智慧，但聰明的貧窮人能將他查透。

verses.text: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, But when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
verses.textZh: 義人得志，有大榮耀；惡人興起，人就躲藏。

verses.text: He who conceals his transgressions will not prosper, But he who confesses and forsakes [them] will find compassion.
verses.textZh: 遮掩自己罪過的，必不亨通；承認離棄罪過的，必蒙憐恤。

verses.text: How blessed is the man who fears always, But he who hardens his heart will fall into calamity.
verses.textZh: 常存敬畏的，便為有福；心存剛硬的，必陷在禍患裡。

verses.text: [Like] a roaring lion and a rushing bear Is a wicked ruler over a poor people.
verses.textZh: 暴虐的君王轄制貧民，好像吼叫的獅子、覓食的熊。

verses.text: A leader who is a great oppressor lacks understanding, [But] he who hates unjust gain will prolong [his] days.
verses.textZh: 無知的君多行暴虐；以貪財為可恨的，必年長日久。

verses.text: A man who is laden with the guilt of human blood Will be a fugitive until death; let no one support him.
verses.textZh: 背負流人血之罪的，必往坑裡奔跑，誰也不可攔阻他。

verses.text: He who walks blamelessly will be delivered, But he who is crooked will fall all at once.
verses.textZh: 行動正直的，必蒙拯救；行事彎曲的，立時跌倒。

verses.text: He who tills his land will have plenty of food, But he who follows empty [pursuits] will have poverty in plenty.
verses.textZh: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食；追隨虛浮的，足受窮乏。

verses.text: A faithful man will abound with blessings, But he who makes haste to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.textZh: 誠實人必多得福；想要急速發財的，不免受罰。

verses.text: To show partiality is not good, Because for a piece of bread a man will transgress.
verses.textZh: 看人的情面乃為不好；人因一塊餅枉法也為不好。

verses.text: A man with an evil eye hastens after wealth And does not know that want will come upon him.
verses.textZh: 人有惡眼想要急速發財，卻不知窮乏必臨到他身。

verses.text: He who rebukes a man will afterward find [more] favor Than he who flatters with the tongue.
verses.textZh: 責備人的，後來蒙人喜悅，多於那用舌頭諂媚人的。

verses.text: He who robs his father or his mother And says, 'It is not a transgression,' Is the companion of a man who destroys.
verses.textZh: 偷竊父母的，說：這不是罪，此人就是與強盜同類。

verses.text: An arrogant man stirs up strife, But he who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
verses.textZh: 心中貪婪的，挑起爭端；倚靠耶和華的，必得豐裕。

verses.text: He who trusts in his own heart is a fool, But he who walks wisely will be delivered.
verses.textZh: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人；憑智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。

verses.text: He who gives to the poor will never want, But he who shuts his eyes will have many curses.
verses.textZh: 賙濟貧窮的，不致缺乏；佯為不見的，必多受咒詛。

verses.text: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.textZh: 惡人興起，人就躲藏；惡人敗亡，義人增多。
